address: 15 Nguyen Trung Truc Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, 700000, Vietnam
bio: On a street corner near Ben Thanh market, this shop has only two dishes on the menu: xôi gà (sticky chicken rice with egg, chicken offal and gravy); and xôi bắp (sticky sweet corn rice with sugar and lard). Both are delicious....
